title: Greatest Common Divisor
description:
Return the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two positive integers `a` and `b` using the Euclidean algorithm. Do not use `math.gcd`.

**Example:**
```
gcd(48, 18) → 6
gcd(100, 75) → 25
gcd(7, 13) → 1
```
hint: Euclidean algorithm: while b != 0, set a, b = b, a % b. Return a.
